privacy.title: Personal Data Processing Policy
privacy.description: Personal data processing policy of Orión Lex Servicios Jurídicos.
privacy.body:
**Orión Lex Servicios Jurídicos** ("Orión Lex") adopts this Personal Data Processing Policy in compliance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, Decree 1377 of 2013 (compiled in Decree 1074 of 2015) and related regulations. The Spanish version is the official one.

## 1. Data controller

- **Name:** Orión Lex Servicios Jurídicos
- **Email:** [abogados@orionlex.co](mailto:abogados@orionlex.co)
- **Phone and WhatsApp:** +57 313 234 4178
- **Website:** [orionlex.co](https://orionlex.co)

## 2. Data we collect

Name, phone number, email, city, the matter you consult us about and the information you choose to share about your case, plus technical browsing data for statistics. Sensitive data (for example, health data in insurance claims) is processed only with your express authorization and for the stated purpose.

## 3. Purposes

To answer your inquiries; evaluate your case and provide legal advice and representation; contact you about your case; comply with legal, contractual and billing obligations; send you legal information only if you authorize it; and produce internal statistics.

## 4. Your rights

You may know, update and correct your data; request proof of your authorization; be informed about its use; revoke the authorization or request deletion when there is no legal duty to keep it; access it free of charge; and file complaints with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

## 5. Requests and complaints

Write to [abogados@orionlex.co](mailto:abogados@orionlex.co) with your full name, ID number, contact details and request. Inquiries are answered within 10 business days (extendable by 5); complaints within 15 business days (extendable by 8).

## 6. Security and confidentiality

We apply reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your data, which is also covered by attorney-client confidentiality. We do not sell your data; it is shared only when needed for your case, by legal obligation, or with technology providers bound by confidentiality.

## 7. Authorization and validity

By contacting us or continuing to browse after the data notice, you authorize processing under this policy. It is effective from its publication; any substantial change will be posted on this page.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.description: Terms and conditions of use of the Orión Lex Servicios Jurídicos website.
terms.body:
These Terms and Conditions govern the use of [orionlex.co](https://orionlex.co) (the "Site"), owned by **Orión Lex Servicios Jurídicos** ("Orión Lex"). By browsing the Site you accept them. The Spanish version is the official one.

## 1. Not legal advice

The content is general and informative. It is not legal advice on any particular case and does not replace a review by a lawyer.

## 2. Attorney-client relationship

Contacting us does not by itself create a representation relationship. It begins only when Orión Lex accepts the case and the scope, conditions and fees are agreed in writing.

## 3. No guarantee of results

Each case depends on its facts, evidence and the decisions of the authorities. Orión Lex acts with diligence and professional ethics but cannot guarantee a specific outcome. Cases and testimonials on the Site do not assure equal results.

## 4. Proper use and intellectual property

Use the Site lawfully and do not try to access restricted areas. Texts, logo, name, photos, videos and design belong to Orión Lex or are used with permission; you may share links and quote short excerpts citing the source.

## 5. Third-party links and personal data

Orión Lex is not responsible for third-party sites. Personal data is processed under our [Personal Data Processing Policy](/privacidad).

## 6. Changes and governing law

Orión Lex may update these terms at any time; the version on this page applies. They are governed by the laws of Colombia. Questions: [abogados@orionlex.co](mailto:abogados@orionlex.co).
